objective: 原四门中心达标，抗扰动更强；提高32点联合及逐项达标率、提高净CAGR Q10及降低全区间DD Q90。最好标准扰动仍达标；不把32/32新增为硬门。

method.zero_tr: Exactly zero legal flat TR gives both0; no epsilon, denominator fallback or price repair.

meaning.negative_gap_repair: Amount of a negative opening gap recovered by T close, capped at prior close and normalized by T true range.
meaning.positive_gap_fade: Amount of a positive opening gap faded by T close, capped at prior close and normalized by T true range.

method.novelty: Nonlinear interactions of already-observed daily prices, not independent new information; overnight_gap/intraday_return remain old controls.

hypotheses_fixed_before_actual_statistic.negative_gap_repair: Higher value predicts stronger return after next open, primarily horizons3/5.
hypotheses_fixed_before_actual_statistic.positive_gap_fade: Higher value predicts weaker post-next-open return and/or higher subsequent downside.

method.strongest_competition: The14 existing controls already fully explain these expressions; any apparent increment comes from nonlinear model form, common market paths, ties or development selection rather than new information.

input_contract.price_basis: Authenticated same-unit HFQ; no actual input read in this module task.
input_contract.index: Unique increasing finite timezone-naive normalized session dates; caller supplies complete authorized full trading calendar.
input_contract.previous: Full daily Close.shift(1) before signal reindex. First requested signal requires real prior session. No fill or prior selected-signal substitution.
input_contract.validation: All supplied daily prices strictly positive, finite, real numeric; High>=max(Open,Close), Low<=min(Open,Close), High>=Low. Reject invalid OHLC unchanged.

method.availability: T complete daily OHLC and prior Close available at T close under existing publication policy; earliest hypothetical entry T+1 open. No claim of independent historical timestamp verification.
method.parameters: None. No fitted window/threshold/epsilon/range/weight; one prior session is data dependency only.
method.output_contract: Exactly both components, original requested signal sessions retained including all zeros. Bounds[0,1] follow valid OHLC/segment lengths, not output clipping.

label_contract.negative_gap_next: Not tested: next open gap is already realized before proposed entry
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

statistics_prospective.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all fourteen controls; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
statistics_prospective.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: full-pool and opportunity-pool only; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 16 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

statistics_prospective.scope: all rows and optional original strategy ex-ante eligibility; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

method.opportunity_pool: Auxiliary original C8880 ex-ante entry_eligible on its original path; main full pool. Never profitable-row or best-year selection.
method.label_profit_boundary: Return_h=Open[T+1+h]/Open[T+1]-1. Next-open gap Close[T] to Open[T+1] precedes proposed entry and is not earned holding return. Labels are not fees-inclusive executable-account PnL.
counterevidence: No consistent fixed-sign partial rank IC or chronological model gain beyond controls weakens usefulness.
Repair may describe short-lived exhaustion; fade may be consolidation before further rise. Predeclared signs are not flipped.
Shared denominator and zero-mass ties can mimic significance; retain ties, all phases/years/failures and control-matched rows.
Positive statistical results still require future authorized complete-account mechanism tests and original hard goals.
method.history: Root has observed EX063 fixed-management centers failing economic gates; this author did not read actual price/account result files for this component preparation.
limits: Already-seen development pool; annual matured-label chronological ridge is not sealed independent validation.
500x40 seed13 block intervals descriptive only, not multiple-selection correction.
Future input identity/calendar/publication authentication and statistics execution belong to separately authorized root driver.
Pure validation tests numerical definitions and time dependency only; no predictiveness, profitability or goal achievement established.

nonlinear_expression_scope.direction_contract: negative_gap_repair return positive; positive_gap_fade return negative and/or downside positive; negative_gap_repair downside diagnostic with no fixed sign. Retain original raw columns, do not invert a failed hypothesis.
nonlinear_expression_scope.zero_mass: Keep exact-zero rows in all original scopes/models/groups; report zero counts and quantile-group overlap. Never condition on an active/nonzero trigger after observing returns.
